subject: QBR prep — portfolio health ladder & renewal priority asks
content:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — portfolio health ladder & renewal priority asks

Hi all,

As we prep for Acme's QBR (proposed week of May 17), I want to surface the current health ladder and call out items that need exec attention. Attached is a quick heatmap (renewal_heatmap.xlsx) with signal tiers. Please review and annotate by EOD Thursday.

Top-line asks:
- Marissa: confirm usage trend anomalies on pages 3–4 (we saw a 28% dip after the LLM upgrade).
- Jordan: verify whether the outstanding support credits request (ref: ticket #7891) is tied to the dip or an unrelated SLA event.
- Erin / Procurement: confirm final PO timing and whether the procurement team needs a revised SOW to process the renewal with the new Dedicated pricing.

Executive attention candidates (prelim):
1) Billing delta of ~$28k due to unanticipated burst usage in March — needs credit approval discussion.
2) Latency SLA misses in EMEA region last month — possible mitigation with pinned Dedicated nodes.
3) Contract clause: data residency addendum requested for EU workloads; legal has a draft but will need legal+sales sign-off.

I plan to consolidate exec asks into a one-pager by Monday and send to Vivek for sign-off. Add comments inline in the shared Drive doc if you have specifics.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
"Redwood Inference — predictable LLM inference at scale"

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — portfolio health ladder & renewal priority asks

Grace — quick pass on the heatmap and a few notes below.

On usage: pages 3–4 show a clear drop on March 12 that aligns with their batch ingestion change. The dip is concentrated on their analytics worker pool (customer tag: acme-analytics-v2). I flagged the cohorts impacted and attached quick notes to the sheet.

Health signals (summary):
- Green (stable): 6/12 services; steady embed cost, <1% error rate.
- Yellow (watch): 4 services; intermittent latency increases on 99th pct due to increased long-context calls.
- Red (at risk): 2 services — one tied to EMEA latency misses, one to a regression in prompt throughput after model variants switched to quantized runtime.

My recommended exec asks:
- Approve one-time credit of $18,000 (partial offset) and a discounted month for remediation work.
- Approve short-term Dedicated burst nodes in EMEA for 6 weeks to stabilize SLA while we patch model runtime configs.
- Greenlight a targeted eval run on quantized model path with Engineering to confirm regression fix before renewal.

Attachments: I uploaded a short runbook (qbr_exec_asks.pdf) with proposed language for executive sign-off.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Looping Vivek for the credit approval lane and to confirm whether we can offer a 4-week grace period while remediation is underway.

Vivek — quick context: Acme experienced a March burst and two SLA MMs in EMEA. Marissa proposes $18k credit + Dedicated burst nodes. We need a decision window by May 11 so procurement can finish PO. If approved, Finance will need the approved credit language for the PO.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 6 May 2027 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: QBR prep — portfolio health ladder & renewal priority asks

Thanks, team. Useful summary — we can confirm timing from procurement: our fiscal onboarding for renewals closes May 21. A couple of clarifications:
- The $18k credit request is acceptable pending formal justification and a one-page remediation plan.
- For the Dedicated burst nodes, we need a clear statement of expected performance improvement and a temporary pricing amendment for the six-week window.
- Data residency: Acme's EU legal team will require the addendum prior to signature; can Redwood provide a one-paragraph summary of controls?

I'll ask procurement to circulate required PO templates by Monday. If you can provide the one-pager and remediation plan by EOD Monday (May 10), we'll be able to slot the renewal into the May 21 close.

Erin Walsh
Director, Cloud Procurement | Acme Analytics

2) Approve temporary Dedicated burst nodes in EMEA for 6 weeks (owner: Engineering + Ops).

Immediate next steps:

- Jordan: capture finance credit language and circulate to Vivek — due EOD Monday.
- Vivek: please review and approve exec asks or call for modification by 8:30am PT Tuesday (May 11) so I can lock the QBR agenda.
